import os, subprocess, pathlib, textwrap, time
base='/workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/espeak-ng'
print('checking files')
for rel in ['tests/ssml-fuzzer.test','tests/ssml-fuzzer','src/espeak-ng']:
    p=pathlib.Path(base)/rel
    print(rel, p.exists(), p.stat().st_size if p.exists() else None)
print('configure exists', (pathlib.Path(base)/'configure').exists())
print('Makefile exists', (pathlib.Path(base)/'Makefile').exists())
